stdout: gbrain mcp — provision access on the host; install it inside the harness
gbrain mcp grant NAME --harness ID --profile PROFILE --source SOURCE --url URL --credentials-out FILE
gbrain mcp grant NAME --client ID --if-version N --profile PROFILE --url URL --harness ID --dry-run
gbrain mcp verify --client ID --harness ID --url URL --credentials-file FILE [--delegate]
expose publishes the gbrain HTTP MCP server on your Tailscale tailnet (--funnel: public, for cloud agents)
and keeps it running as a user service. Engine-free. See: gbrain mcp expose --help
--profile defaults to memory-writer for new clients; omitted profiles preserve existing grants.
New connections follow this brain's published skills within their approved read sources.
--skills follow|memory-only         Follow shared skills (new default) or use memory only; existing grants are unchanged when omitted
Following never grants skill editing, script execution, additional tools, or paid calls.
--budget-usd-per-day USD|unlimited Default for new clients: unlimited
--credentials-out FILE             Private credential handoff (required for creation)
--credentials-file FILE            Existing private handoff; never printed
--resume                           Recover the original private handoff for --client
--delegate                         Execute a real worker check; may incur model charges
--dry-run                          Preview grant without mutation or credentials
Next, in the intended harness environment:
Thin CLI adapters additionally require --root ABSOLUTE-PERSISTENT-DIRECTORY.

Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain export` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: export dumps the host brain to disk and has no MCP equivalent. Run `gbrain export` on the host, or read pages with the `get_page` MCP tool.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain files` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: `files list` and `files url` MCP ops are localOnly (paths live on the host filesystem). Use `gbrain files` on the host machine.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain embed` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: embed runs on the host. Run `gbrain embed` or `gbrain cycle` on the host machine.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain serve` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: serve starts a server. Run on the host, not the thin client.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain sweep` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: sweep runs the serve-resident maintenance passes against the LOCAL engine. Run it on the host (the serve process also runs it automatically).
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain config` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.

Why: config reads/writes the host brain's config plane. Edit the host's .gbrain/config.json (file-plane keys) or run on the host with GBRAIN_HOME set. self_upgrade.* keys are machine-local and work here.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain pricing` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.

Why: pricing registers model prices in the host brain's config and is trusted-local only (a remote caller could void a cost cap). Ask the brain's operator to run `gbrain pricing set <model> ...` on the host.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain migrate` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: migrate runs on the host's local engine. Run on the host machine.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain retrieval-upgrade` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: retrieval-upgrade (embedding migration) rebuilds the host brain's schema + re-embeds. Run on the host machine.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain eval` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.
Why: `eval` export/prune/replay touch the local engine and have no MCP equivalents. Run `gbrain eval` on the host.
Error [requires_local_engine]: `gbrain jobs` is not routable (thin-client of http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp); run it on the brain host.

Why: `jobs list`, `jobs get <id>`, and `jobs stats` are thin-client routable; this subcommand runs against the host queue. Use the submit_job / list_jobs / get_job / get_job_stats MCP tools from your agent, or run on the host with GBRAIN_HOME set.

Without --save, the synthesis is printed to stdout and discarded. With --save,
the synthesis page is persisted AND printed. If --save is given but no synthesis
was produced (no LLM available, or empty result), nothing is saved and the command
Dates: the reader sees today's date in brain.timezone and each page's content
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or run: gbrain config set anthropic_api_key ...) to run

prints what would have been the input (exit 0).
